feeds.title: Simple Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jamie C. Martin, and I hold the title of an editor around these parts along with the titles of mama, wife, teacher, and author. On the Simple Homeschool blog, you'll find inspiration and help as a homeschool mom. Key Topics covered are curriculum, family time, field trips, methods & philosophies, mom's education, and organization.

feeds.title: Jalisa Harris
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jalisa. A Millennial mom of 2 in New England. I'm here to help you live your best life the simple way. I share all things to help you be that cool mom with Mom lifestyle, mom hacks, simple recipes and wellness.

feeds.title: An Artful Mom Blog
feeds.description: I share creative lifestyle ideas at my blog for art/craft, photography, lettering, home, family, journaling, food, simple living. I'm Pam, a wife, mom to two adult kids, reading tutor, and a seriously lacking (but not hopeless), follower of Jesus Christ. I'm an introvert, but I love to make connections, and my blog is a safe place to do that

feeds.title: The Millennial Stay-At-Home Mom
feeds.description: I'm Kermilia! I'm an introverted millennial, married to the love of my life, and a SAHM to two amazing little boys and one sweet baby girl. I'm a Christian, self-proclaimed cup connoisseur, audiobook collector, and the queen of 5 ingredient recipes.

feeds.title: Emily Prokop Blog
feeds.description: A personal blog dedicated to my love of expressing myself through writing, and being a little tongue-in-cheek at times. Busy mom, wife and introvert.Current topics of interest you may see me writing about: parenting, ADHD, podcasting, Adenomyosis, LGBTQ+ Pride, and most likely whatever new thing I've been noodling lately.

feeds.title: Hope Above All
feeds.description: This blog will take you along as we navigate this crazy life and its many ups and downs with Hope amidst the chaos of life. An introvert, daughter and husband struggle with depression, and extroverted son is off conquering the world.

feeds.title: Retired Introvert Blog
feeds.description: A blog about navigating retirement as an introvert. As a retiree, Author Linda shares her experiences and how it fits with her introverted personality. You don't have to be retired or an introvert to enjoy the blog.

feeds.title: Book Obsessed Introverts
feeds.description: We share reviews of our latest reads, as well as anything book-related. We are huge fans of mystery & thriller novels but we also occasionally enjoy romance novels. The blog is maintained by three introverted ladies.

feeds.title: Becky Baudouin Blog
feeds.description: I'm an author, speaker, and former columnist for Chicago's Daily Herald. I love to weave together personal stories with transformative truths to encourage and equip others who are walking through the ups and downs of everyday life. I'm a friendly introvert, a self-described homebody, and if you're looking for me, I'm probably in the kitchen.

feeds.title: The Rambling Introvert
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Jess and welcome to The Rambling Introvert! I'm a Disney-obsessed girl mom who navigates life with OCD. Here you'll find tons of Disney insights, parenting tips, and advice on mental illness. The Rambling Introvert came from two counteracting parts of my personality. I am an introvert and am very shy around new people.

feeds.title: Introverted Moms Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog to know more about my life, daily hustles, managing as an introvert and more! Hi there! I'm Jamie, an introverted mom who loves the countryside, writing, traveling, and reading. I met my British husband Steve when I was sixteen years old and ventured overseas to volunteer with a humanitarian organization for the summer.

feeds.title: An Introverted Blogger
feeds.description: With this blog I hope to share with you personal anecdotes, life experiences, my love for baking and fitness - (fitness because of the incessant need to bake and eat), and hope for the blog to emerge as a melting pot of some interesting reading! Introvert, gym rat, book lover and avid baker. Perfectionist by nature with perhaps a so-called 'tiger mom' parenting style. Irrational fear of cats, short and long haul flights.
